title: Three Against One
summary: The final melee of the Inner Academy Qualifying Competition goes on at Jia Nan Academy. Xiao Yan starts to advance in the middle of the fight, and Xun Er guards him. Bai Shan talks Wu Hao and Hu Jia into a three-against-one attack, and Xun Er is hurt shielding Xiao Yan with her Golden Trigram Palm. Xiao Yan finishes his advancement, uses the Green Lotus Change of the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes to fight with a Dou Ling's power, and beats all three with the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame. Vice Dean Hu Qian names the top five: Hu Jia, Bai Shan, Wu Hao, Xun Er and Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan tells his cousin Xiao Mei what happened to the Xiao Clan and forgives her for the past. The top five then enter the Book Collection Hall after two hall elders open its Space Lock.
events: Xiao Yan begins to advance during the melee; Xun Er stays to protect him.
Bai Shan, Wu Hao and Hu Jia join forces; Xun Er is hurt and swears to leave the academy if Bai Shan walks away unhurt.
Xiao Yan completes his advancement and uses the Green Lotus Change.
He beats the three with the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, holding back its full power.
The top five are announced: Hu Jia, Bai Shan, Wu Hao, Xun Er and Xiao Yan.
Xiao Yan tells Xiao Mei about the clan and they make peace.
Two elders guard the Book Collection Hall; one silently recognises the Green Lotus Core Flame. Yao Lao cuts his link with Xiao Yan.
The elders open the Space Lock and the five go in.
